objects.description: Alias for size_t used to represent external point identifiers (labels) within hnswlib. Useful for clarity and portability across platforms.

Abstract functor interface for filtering labels during searches. Default implementation allows all ids. Users can derive and override operator() to exclude certain labels. No ownership or lifecycle constraints indicated in this header.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseFilterFunctor::operator()
functions.description: Predicate functor used to filter candidate labels during search. Default implementation always returns true (allows all ids). Typically passed to search methods to restrict which labels may appear in results.
requirements: May be overridden in user subclasses to implement custom filtering.
Must be callable with any valid hnswlib::labeltype label id.
Should be side‑effect free or reentrant if used concurrently (not specified; depends on user implementation).

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseFilterFunctor::~BaseFilterFunctor
functions.description: Virtual destructor for BaseFilterFunctor to allow safe deletion via base pointer.
requirements: No special requirements; ensure any derived resources are released in overriding destructors if needed.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::add_point_to_result
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual void hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition<dist_t>::add_point_to_result(hnswlib::labeltype label, const void *datapoint, dist_t dist) = 0
functions.description: Interface hook invoked when a point is added to the current search result set. Used by custom stop conditions to track state and potentially decide when to stop.
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.
datapoint must be a valid pointer to the underlying data object associated with label (type/size depends on the space).
dist is the computed distance for datapoint; must be consistent with the space’s distance metric.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::remove_point_from_result
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual void hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition<dist_t>::remove_point_from_result(hnswlib::labeltype label, const void *datapoint, dist_t dist) = 0
functions.description: Interface hook invoked when a point is removed from the current search result set (e.g., trimming to a result size).
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.
datapoint must be a valid pointer corresponding to label.
dist must match the distance associated with the removed point.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::should_stop_search
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual bool hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition<dist_t>::should_stop_search(dist_t candidate_dist, dist_t lowerBound) = 0
functions.description: Decides whether the search can be terminated based on the current best candidate distance and the current result lower bound (worst distance in the result set).
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.
candidate_dist and lowerBound must be distances in the same metric and units used by the space.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::should_consider_candidate
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual bool hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition<dist_t>::should_consider_candidate(dist_t candidate_dist, dist_t lowerBound) = 0
functions.description: Determines if a newly discovered candidate (with distance candidate_dist) should be considered for inclusion compared to the current lowerBound.
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.
candidate_dist and lowerBound must be comparable values from the same distance metric.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::should_remove_extra
functions.description: Indicates whether extra points beyond the intended result count should be removed immediately (e.g., to keep a fixed-size result set).
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::filter_results
functions.description: Allows a stop condition to post-process and filter the final set of candidate results in-place.
requirements: Must be implemented by subclasses.
candidates must be a valid, mutable vector of (distance,label) pairs; implementers may reorder, remove, or modify entries.

functions.name: hnswlib::BaseSearchStopCondition::~BaseSearchStopCondition
functions.description: Virtual destructor for BaseSearchStopCondition to allow proper cleanup via base pointers.
requirements: No special requirements; subclasses should release any owned resources.

functions.name: hnswlib::SpaceInterface::get_data_size
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of a single data point in this space. Used to interpret raw pointers to data.
requirements: Must be implemented by concrete SpaceInterface implementations.
Return value must match the actual per-point byte size expected by the space’s distance function.

functions.name: hnswlib::SpaceInterface::get_dist_func
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the distance function for this space that computes distance between two data points using an optional parameter.
requirements: Must be implemented by concrete SpaceInterface implementations.
Returned function pointer must be valid for the lifetime of the space object.
The function must have signature MTYPE(const void*, const void*, const void*).

functions.name: hnswlib::SpaceInterface::get_dist_func_param
functions.description: Returns an opaque parameter to be passed to the distance function (e.g., dimensionality or context).
requirements: Must be implemented by concrete SpaceInterface implementations.
Returned pointer must remain valid while used with the associated distance function.

functions.name: hnswlib::SpaceInterface::~SpaceInterface
functions.description: Virtual destructor for SpaceInterface to enable deletion through base pointers.
requirements: No special requirements; concrete implementations should free any owned resources.

functions.name: hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface::addPoint
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual void hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface<dist_t>::addPoint(const void *datapoint, hnswlib::labeltype label, bool replace_deleted = false) = 0
functions.description: Adds a new datapoint with the given label to the index. If replace_deleted is true, implementations may reuse slots of previously deleted elements with the same label.
requirements: Must be implemented by a concrete index algorithm (e.g., HNSW).
datapoint must point to a valid data object compatible with the associated SpaceInterface (type and length depend on the space).
label must be a valid, unique identifier according to the implementation’s policy; behavior on duplicates depends on the implementation and replace_deleted flag.
replace_deleted controls replacement behavior; exact semantics are implementation-defined.

functions.name: hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface::searchKnn
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> virtual std::priority_queue<std::pair<dist_t, hnswlib::labeltype>> hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface<dist_t>::searchKnn(const void* query_data, size_t k, hnswlib::BaseFilterFunctor* isIdAllowed = nullptr) const = 0
functions.description: Performs a k-nearest neighbors search for query_data and returns a max-heap (furthest-first) priority_queue of (distance,label) pairs. Optional filter functor can restrict which labels are considered.
requirements: Must be implemented by a concrete index algorithm.
query_data must point to a valid data object compatible with the space’s distance function.
k is the number of neighbors requested; behavior for k == 0 is unspecified.
isIdAllowed may be null to disable filtering; if provided, it must remain valid for the duration of the call.
This method does not modify the index (const-qualified).

functions.name: hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface::searchKnnCloserFirst
functions.signature: template<typename dist_t> std::vector<std::pair<dist_t, hnswlib::labeltype>> hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface<dist_t>::searchKnnCloserFirst(const void* query_data, size_t k, hnswlib::BaseFilterFunctor* isIdAllowed = nullptr) const
functions.description: Helper that calls searchKnn and converts the result to a vector sorted from closest to furthest. Intended for convenience when an ordered result is needed.
requirements: query_data must point to a valid data object compatible with the space’s distance function.
k is the number of neighbors requested; behavior for k == 0 is unspecified.
isIdAllowed may be null to disable filtering; if provided, it must remain valid for the duration of the call.
Relies on a working implementation of searchKnn in the concrete class.

functions.name: hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface::saveIndex
functions.description: Serializes and saves the index to the specified filesystem location.
requirements: Must be implemented by a concrete index algorithm.
location must identify a writable target (file path or similar) understood by the implementation.
Caller must have sufficient permissions to write to location; errors are implementation-defined (may throw or log).

functions.name: hnswlib::AlgorithmInterface::~AlgorithmInterface
functions.description: Virtual destructor for AlgorithmInterface, allowing cleanup via base pointer.
requirements: No special requirements; concrete implementations should release owned resources.
